description:
She was pushed into the freezing abyssal waves just to be mocked... 🌊🔥

Until the water in her lungs turned into the POWER of a GODDESS! 🔱😱

(Click to watch the ultimate ocean revenge unfold! 👇)

Sophia grew up as a humble waitress on a luxury cruise, constantly humiliated by the rich and powerful. On a stormy night, a spoiled heiress rips away Sophia's only keepsakes and shoves her into the merciless ocean deep. But instead of drowning, an ancient gold trident mark ignites on her skin—and a giant Leviathan answers her call from the abyss... 🌊⚔️

#ShortDrama #Poseidon #OceanGod #HiddenPrincess #Revenge #PlotTwist
